tiers.confirmed: BY-FDR q <= 0.05 across the whole tested family AND an independent corroboration (re-detected in disjoint years, or a second estimator agrees)
tiers.detected: BY-FDR q <= 0.05 without corroboration yet, or z >= 3 against the site's own 24 pseudo-site null
tiers.not detected: z < 2; an 84th-percentile upper limit is reported

fdr.statement: Among confirmed sites, the expected share of false entries is <= 5% (Benjamini-Yekutieli, valid under arbitrary dependence).

oversight.statement: Entries are machine candidates for human review, not accusations. An analyst or a regulatory partner records every decision (data-pipeline/review/decisions.json).

method.stack: wind-rotated, footprint-drizzled, plane background, monsoon (Jun-Sep) excluded, noise-weighted, albedo/AOT bias removed (ABD)
method.calibration: x gamma (ERA5 100 m / 10 m wind) / OBC slope 0.992
method.uncertainty: Monte Carlo 4000: overpass bootstrap + null structure + gamma
